sources.title: LTX-2.5 Model Open Source: AI Video Generator
sources.snippet: LTX-2.5 is an open source AI video generator built on a diffusion transformer architecture for production, research, education, and experimentation.

sources.title: LTX (text-to-video model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: LTX-2.5 reported to add native multishot generation and a pretrained checkpoint intended for domain-specific fine-tuning. The release continued LTX's development as a world model, with applications including robotics and physical AI.
